draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kakkanad! This was a cluster of villages among paddy fields and wetlands not that long ago. Now it's the headquarters of Ernakulam district and home to Infopark and SmartCity Kochi.
draft.hungryLine: If you're heading to Wonderla, it has five restaurants and small cafes inside the park.

moodReplies.show-me-around: St. Francis Assisi church is a 5 min walk, and Wonderla, the second largest theme park in South India, is right here in Kakkanad.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Wonderla has well kept gardens alongside its rides if you want a slower afternoon.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory in nearby Thrikkakara is a DRDO lab that develops sonar systems for underwater surveillance.

spots.name: St. John The Baptist Orthodox Syrian Church

tips.title: Give Wonderla a full day.
tips.body: It opens 9:30AM to 7PM and has more than 50 rides and shows.

tips.title: Expect office traffic.
tips.body: Kakkanad holds the Civil Station, Infopark and the Cochin Special Economic Zone, so roads get busy.

story.title: Paddy and wetlands
story.body: Kakkanad was a cluster of villages surrounded by paddy fields and wetlands.

story.title: Offices arrive
story.body: Government offices moved in, then the IT sector, and Kakkanad became one of the fastest-growing parts of Kochi.

story.title: Special Economic Zone
story.body: One of India's first Export Processing Zones, here in Kakkanad, became the Cochin Special Economic Zone.

story.title: Your turn
story.body: Tech parks, the district Collectorate and a theme park, all in one suburb. Tell me which one you visited.
